nodes.name: Daily - 07:00
nodes.notes: Default daily at 07:00 (cron 0 7 * * *). Adjust to weekly if you prefer a weekly digest.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Name, Owner.Name, Renewal_Date__c, ARR__c FROM Account WHERE Renewal_Date__c >= TODAY AND Renewal_Date__c <= NEXT_N_DAYS:90

nodes.name: CRM - renewals next 90d
nodes.notes: Resolve the real renewal-date field (do not hardcode a label). Read-only. Bucket the rows into 30/60/90-day horizons downstream.

nodes.name: Recorder - account calls (90d)
nodes.notes: Join calls to each renewing account. For many accounts, precede with a Split In Batches loop. No Gong? Swap for your recorder's API, or ingest exports via the gtmsi adapters.

nodes.name: Slack - post renewal digest
nodes.notes: Post to the renewals / account-management channel.
